weaknesses: The abstract inaccurately describes the contributions, focusing on safety alignment in LLMs rather than the implicit regularization of deep residual networks.
The claims regarding the convergence of residual networks to neural ODEs are not clearly supported by the results presented in the abstract.
The novelty of the findings is overstated, as the relationship between residual networks and neural ODEs has been previously explored without sufficient acknowledgment of prior work.
The scope of the abstract does not align with the content of the paper, which primarily addresses theoretical aspects rather than practical applications.
